purpose: Regression probes for predictive transliteration, not a claim of linguistic certification or a substitute for a held-out benchmark.
normalization: Compare NFC-normalized Unicode. Keep meaningful distinctions; do not delete vowel marks, viramas, nukta or joiners to make a test pass.

evaluation.top1: The first candidate equals at least one expected spelling.
evaluation.top5: At least one expected spelling occurs among the first five unique candidates.
evaluation.userConfirmedBlockers: Every user-confirmed blocker must pass top1 and the whole editor flow. Native vocabulary and names also need measurement; fixing only the reported phrase is insufficient.
evaluation.developerProbes: These common-word expectations are review probes. They have not been certified by native speakers. Record failures and inspect alternatives rather than claiming a percentage for an entire language.
evaluation.accuracyClaim: Do not describe this small probe set as model accuracy, a blind test or perfection. Use an untouched published test split and native-speaker review before publishing comparative accuracy claims.
evaluation.candidateRequirements: Ranked, non-empty, duplicate-free Unicode strings; raw Roman input remains a selectable alternative. Selecting a choice must preserve that exact word on subsequent edits.

sources.detail: The user explicitly requested Kannada tea day -> ಟೀ ಡೇ, English sounds rather than translation.
The supplied screenshot shows tea with a ranked candidate list whose first choice is ಟೀ. This establishes interaction behavior, not a supported production API contract.
The upstream model documents uneven top-1 performance across languages and named entities. Word prediction cannot guarantee the writer's intended spelling.

The official dataset has separate test material and source/annotation information. Use its untouched test split with attribution; do not add a test-derived dictionary then report the same split as independent evaluation.

interactionCases.steps: In Kannada smart typing, type tea slowly without a space.
interactionCases.expect: The result and the first candidate become ಟೀ after prediction completes; candidates appear while the source word is active. No translation to ಚಹಾ is substituted.

interactionCases.steps: Type a word with several candidates, select a non-first candidate, then type a space and another word.
interactionCases.expect: The chosen spelling survives re-render and later prediction. The selection applies to the intended source span, not the whole passage.

interactionCases.steps: Keep source input focused. Use ArrowDown/ArrowUp and Enter to choose a candidate, and Escape to dismiss it.
interactionCases.expect: Candidate focus and selection are announced accessibly. Caret position and text remain intact. Ordinary editing keys keep their expected behavior when no candidate list is open.

interactionCases.steps: Type tea day, move the caret back inside tea, and select its alternative.
interactionCases.expect: Only tea is replaced. day and all following spaces remain intact. Subsequent candidate responses for day do not alter tea.

interactionCases.steps: Delay prediction for tea; immediately replace it with day. Resolve the day response first and then the old tea response.
interactionCases.expect: The source stays day, result stays ಡೇ, and the old tea response cannot repaint the result or candidates.

interactionCases.steps: Delay a Kannada response, switch to Hindi, and resolve the older Kannada response afterward.
interactionCases.expect: No Kannada candidate or output appears under the Hindi language label. Cache keys include both language and normalized word.

interactionCases.steps: Type while the model loads and press Clear or Undo before it completes.
interactionCases.expect: Late model responses do not restore cleared text or overwrite the restored history entry.

interactionCases.steps: Delay conversion; edit the result manually before it resolves.
interactionCases.expect: A late automatic response does not silently overwrite the user's result edit. Explicit Convert text may replace it with a clear editing state.

interactionCases.steps: Choose On space, type tea and then a space.
interactionCases.expect: The unfinished source word stays Roman until committed; a trailing space commits ಟೀ and preserves the space. Suggestions may still be offered before commit.

interactionCases.steps: Choose Whole passage, paste tea day, then press Convert text.
interactionCases.expect: The result changes only on explicit conversion and becomes ಟೀ ಡೇ. Candidate selection remains coherent with the pending passage.

interactionCases.steps: Enable English preview during an in-flight native conversion.
interactionCases.expect: The result exactly matches the source; delayed native output cannot override English preview.

interactionCases.steps: Use an operating-system native IME and finish composition in the source textarea.
interactionCases.expect: Preedit text is not repeatedly converted or damaged; completed native text is preserved.

interactionCases.steps: Choose every language without a matching predictive model, including script variants that do not match the model.
interactionCases.expect: The interface clearly labels basic sound mapping; it does not silently use another language's predictions or imply full predictive spelling support.

interactionCases.steps: Block the model or WebAssembly download; reload and type tea day.
interactionCases.expect: A visible, actionable load error appears. The interface cannot label approximate basic mapping as a successful smart result. Retry is possible.

interactionCases.steps: Load with a slow connection and type on a narrow mobile viewport.
interactionCases.expect: The download/progress state is visible, the editor remains responsive, and candidates remain reachable without horizontal page overflow.

interactionCases.steps: Inspect all requests while typing, selecting candidates and switching languages.
interactionCases.expect: Typed text appears in no request URL, request body, telemetry or remote prediction endpoint; only same-origin static engine/model asset requests are needed.

interactionCases.steps: Paste literal <script>alert(1)</script> and an HTML-looking candidate string into editable text.
interactionCases.expect: Content remains text; it cannot create elements, execute code or alter the page.

interactionCases.steps: Paste 20,000 characters, a 200-character unbroken Roman token, and many repeated tokens.
interactionCases.expect: Limits remain explicit, work stays bounded off the main UI thread, repeated words reuse predictions, and unsupported overlong words are preserved rather than dropped.
